TestSteps: Navigate to Add Employee;Enter valid details;Click Save

TestSteps: Navigate to Add Employee;Leave mandatory fields empty;Click Save

Title: Search employee by name
TestSteps: Navigate to Employee List;Enter employee name;Click Search

Title: Edit employee details
TestSteps: Search employee;Edit details;Click Save

Title: Add employee with very long first name
TestSteps: Navigate to Add Employee;Enter first name with 100+ charachters;Click Save
ExpectedResult: System should restrict input or show validation message

TestSteps: Navigate to Add Employee;Fill information;Click Refresh without saving

TestSteps: Navigate to Employee List;Enter invalid employee name;Click Search

Title: Delete an existing employee
TestSteps: Navigate to Employee List and Delete an existing employee;Click Confirm

Title: Add a new employee with existing record
TestSteps: Navigate to Add Employee;Enter existing employee details;Click Save

Title: Assign leave to employee
TestSteps: Navigate to Assign Leave;Select employee;Enter leave details;Submit

Title: Apply leave with past date
TestSteps: Navigate to Assign Leave;Select employee;Enter leave with past date;Submit
ExpectedResult: System should not allow submitting leave for past dates

TestSteps: Navigate to Assign Leave;Assign Leave to an employee;Check Leave balance
ExpectedResult: Balance changes based on leave type and days

TestSteps: Navigate to Assign Leave;Assign Leave to an employee;Check Leave List

Title: Leave status updated correctly(pending-approved-denied
TestSteps: Navigate to Assign Leave;Reject Leave;Check Leave List

Title: Add new candidate
TestSteps: Navigate to Recruitment;Add candidate details;Save

Title: Add candidate with missing mandatory fields
TestSteps: Navigate to Recruitment;Leave mandatory fields empty;Click Save

Title: Schedule interview
TestSteps: Navigate to Recruitment;Setup an interview;Click Save

TestSteps: Navigate to Recruitment;Approve a candidate;Check Status

Title: Session timeout after inactivity
TestSteps: Stay inactive for 30 minutes
ExpectedResult: Timeout and the user to be logged out
Note: User redirected to login on any action

Title: Access internal page after logout using back button
TestSteps: Click on user menu;Click Logout;Click browser back button
ExpectedResult: User should not access system without login
Note: Page accessible via browser cache, but user redirected to login on any action

Title: Verify required fields show validation messages
TestSteps: Open a form;Leave all required fields empty;Click Save/Submit
ExpectedResult: Validation messages are displayed for all required fields

Title: Verify error messages are user-friendly
TestSteps: Enter invalid data in input field;Click submit
ExpectedResult: Clear and understandable error messages are displayed

Title: Verify application behavior on browser refresh
TestSteps: Navigate to any internal page;Refresh the browser
ExpectedResult: Application behaves correctly without data loss or errors

Title: Verify application displays proper success messages
TestSteps: Perform a valid action;Click submit
